capture_note: The original command returned stdout in two consecutive tool-output chunks. This log reassembles those captured chunks; the command did not originally redirect stdout to disk.
verification: Actual browser UI against the local application backend and synthetic TorBox fixture.
Existing cached and automatic source resolution remains cache-only.
Only explicit Prepare & Play starts an uncached torrent in the fixture.
Automatic and warm lookups omit refresh; explicit Check again requests refresh=1.
Resume plays at 30-35 seconds after the saved 40-second position and 10-second rewind; Start over plays below 5 seconds.
Media handoff is an empty 307 response to the synthetic CDN; the app media fetch counter stays zero in every case.
limitations: Synthetic local account, source-index responses, cache state, and generated MP4 only. No real TorBox credentials, live account inventory, external index availability, real Android device, or production playback was exercised by this browser suite.
